content:
maria-l: Quick heads-up — planning to roll audit schema v4 on Tue. This includes new KMS-related fields, RBAC delta fields, and an event_source tag. Need docs + a customer-facing sample pack and a changelog. Who can own the changelog and sample payloads?
aj-chen: @maria-l what's the compatibility guarantee? Is this a breaking change or additive?
maria-l: It's additive for ingestion. We are deprecating a few fields (actor.identity -> actor.principal) but will emit both for 90 days and mark deprecated in changelog. We'll call out any parsing changes for customers.
samir: I'll draft sample payloads for kms.rotate / kms.encrypt / kms.decrypt. I’ll include hosted and private/HSM variants — HSM will have extra attrs like `hsm_module_id`.
devsec: For RBAC, we need `rbac.operation` and `rbac.resource_path` fields. Confirm mapping from AuthZ service so the emitted strings match what policy engine expects.
pm-eli: Also please include a short "what customers need to do" section — private customers with custom parsers will need examples & jq filters.
aj-chen: We should provide a validator script customers can run against the sample pack (node/python). Will prevent parsing surprises.
maria-l: @samir or @aj-chen can you produce a single-file validator + a couple CI tests? Name suggestion: audit-schema-validator.
samir: I can do a python validator + pytest. Example payload we’ll include in the pack:
```json
{
  "event_type": "kms.rotate",
  "actor": {"principal": "user:alice"},
  "details": {"kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abc123"},
  "rbac": {"operation": "update", "resource_path": "/projects/prod/*"}
}
```
devsec: Add guidance on PII redaction and hashing of KMS key IDs in customer-facing samples (e.g., sha256 prefix). Also add a short section on retention and legal requirements.
maria-l: Plan to publish: 1) changelog PR 2) sample pack (12 events) 3) migration guide 4) validator + CI. Timeline: draft by Fri, internal review Mon, public announcement Wed.
audit-bot: draft PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/audit-schemas/pulls/342 :eyes:
pm-eli: I'll draft the customer announcement + support FAQ. Let's include an opt-in early preview for larger customers.
support-bot: support ticket created #1142 — "audit schema v4 customer comms".
aj-chen: tiny nit — include a field glossary mapping old->new and jq examples to help quick migrations.
maria-l: good call. Samir can you add jq snippets in the sample pack?
samir: yep. quick example:
```bash
jq '.actor.principal // .actor.identity | select(.!=null)' sample.json
```
devsec: Note: Dedicated customers running runtime <=1.8 need to flip a config toggle to emit full RBAC fields. Add a clear callout in the changelog and migration guide.
maria-l: I'll assemble the PR with checklist and attach the sample pack. Ping security for review when sample pack is attached. @audit-bot please run the schema linter on PR.
audit-bot: lint passed — 0 errors.
pm-eli: For comms line: "Audit schema v4: clearer KMS fields, RBAC deltas, and migration steps — preview available" :loud_sound:
maria-l: Thanks everyone. If there are no blockers we'll ship the draft by EOD Friday and sync Mon for review.
